title: Conductor Skill Registry (schemaVersion 1)
description: The set of bindable Claude Code skill ids the WorkflowDefinitionValidator checks a `skill` Step against (COND-18 AC-P0-2.5), and the metadata the Builder shows when binding one. A Workflow definition's `steps[].skill` must reference an `id` present here, or Publish is blocked. Skills run locally (Claude Code drives, MCP reports); this registry is the backend's knowledge of which skill ids are valid — it does NOT execute them.

id.description: The bindable skill id referenced by a definition's steps[].skill (e.g. conductor:implement).

producesAssetTypes.description: Asset types this skill may record (advisory; helps the Builder warn if a bound Workflow lacks the asset_type).

supportsBlocking.description: Whether BLOCKING is a meaningful mode for this skill. For a skill Step, BLOCKING is an advisory convention the local driver honors (the engine never runs the skill).
